answer: Proof-of-stake mechanisms establish Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a stake, effectively creating an economic barrier to entry. Much like a rare opal, the intrinsic value of the staked asset forces the attacker to bear the delta of opportunity cost for every identity created. If a malicious entity attempts to overwhelm the network, they must commit excessive juniper resources to maintain voting weight, rendering the attack prohibitively expensive compared to potential gains.
